minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, June 21, 2023
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at 10:00 AM on Wednesday, June 21, 2023.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, Bette Donovan,
  Edward Padgett, Jenny Jolly

  Members Absent: Scott Snider and Rafaela Giles.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director

  Guest Present: Members of the Tuesday Morning Bible Reading Group

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, May
  17, 2023, meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: none

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Grab-n-Go Meals: Meals were distributed to an average of 148 participants per
  week in May.

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 36 participants per week
  in May.

  Meals on Wheels: 749 meals served to 41 La Verne recipients in May.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month of May was
  $1599.11. The average attendance for May was 65 players per week.

5. Account Balance: $5,725.25

6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Classes going well.
 8. Aging Next: May total number of La Verne residents served was 7 (via
  Joslyn Center and Aging Next office).

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: New Fire Marshal inspected all facilities and had a great
  report. All passed the inspection.

10. Upcoming Events:

  - Saturday, June 24 – Family Night Swim, 4:00PM

  9:30 AM

  - Tuesday, August 1 – National Night Out, 4:30PM
